name: Soybean Crush Spread — Processing Margin Analysis
description: CBOT board crush spread: (ZM × 44/2000) + (ZL × 11/100) − (ZS/100). Shows the gross processing margin for crushing soybeans into meal and oil. Includes 60-day rolling z-score to flag historically cheap/rich margins, with event markers at ±2σ extremes.
source:
# Soybean Crush Spread — CBOT Board Crush Formula
# Crush = (ZM × 44/2000) + (ZL × 11/100) − (ZS/100)
# All converted to $/bushel of soybeans
# NoAdjustment required — formula uses absolute price levels

# --- Data: Load all three legs via reference_futures + continuation ---
zs_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zs_raw.o, zs_raw.h, zs_raw.l, zs_raw.c, zs_raw.v, zs_raw.oi, zs_raw.s)

zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)

zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

# --- Crush Spread Calculation ---
# ZS: cents/bushel → $/bushel = ZS/100
# ZM: $/short ton, 44 lbs meal per bushel → ZM × 44/2000
# ZL: cents/lb, 11 lbs oil per bushel → ZL × 11/100
soybean_cost = zs.c / 100.0
meal_revenue = zm.c * 44.0 / 2000.0
oil_revenue = zl.c * 11.0 / 100.0
crush_spread = meal_revenue + oil_revenue - soybean_cost

# --- Z-Score: Is the margin historically cheap or rich? ---
crush_zscore = zscore(window=252)(crush_spread)

# --- Percentile rank for summary context ---
crush_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(crush_spread)

# --- Event detection: z-score extremes at ±2σ ---
ts = index()()
is_rich = is_valid(crush_zscore) and crush_zscore > 2.0
is_cheap = is_valid(crush_zscore) and crush_zscore < -2.0
is_extreme = is_rich or is_cheap
regime_label = conditional_select(is_rich, "Rich", is_cheap, "Cheap", "Normal")

# --- Output 1: Crush Spread Level Over Time ---
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Crush Spread — Where Is the Margin Now?',
    category='Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='$/bushel',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Spread', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=crush_spread)

# --- Output 2: Z-Score Regime — Cheap or Rich? ---
xy_lines(
    title='Crush Margin Z-Score — Historically Cheap or Rich?',
    category='Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score (252d)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Mean'),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Rich (+2σ)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Cheap (−2σ)')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=2.0, to=4.0, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.08, label='Rich'),
        PlotBand(from=-4.0, to=-2.0, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.08, label='Cheap')
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=crush_zscore)

# --- Output 3: Summary Table — Key Stats ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Crush Spread Snapshot',
        row_size=3, col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Current Spread', 'Z-Score (252d)', 'Percentile (252d)'],
        col_headers=['Value', 'Historical Range'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Median crush spread'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Median z-score (should be ~0)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, info='Median percentile')
        ]
    ),
    category='Crush Spread',
    order=3
)(crush_spread, crush_spread, crush_zscore, crush_zscore, crush_pctrank, crush_pctrank)

# --- Event Markers: Flag ±2σ Extremes ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Crush Spread Extreme',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Regime', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Crush Spread', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Percentile', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(regime_label, crush_spread, crush_zscore, crush_pctrank, is_extreme)
